summary.text: Brenda Buchanan is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 54 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Republican Kellie Deeter.
A longtime radio traffic director and former school board member, she also ran for the seat in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Brenda Buchanan grew up in a working-class family in Berea, Ohio, and earned a bachelor's degree from Kent State University in 1985 and a graduate degree from Cleveland State University in 2020.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has worked for nearly 40 years as a radio traffic director in the Cleveland market and is currently Traffic Supervisor for the Audacy New England region.
Buchanan said she and her husband have lived in Columbia Township for 30 years.
She said she served two terms on the Columbia Local Schools Board of Education from 2008 to 2015, including four years as president.
Buchanan was the Democratic nominee for District 54 in 2024, when Kellie Deeter defeated her in the general election, 65.5 percent to 34.5 percent.

In the 2024 survey, Buchanan said she would work to protect Ohio's 2023 reproductive-rights constitutional amendment and to prevent the weakening of public schools, citing the state's expansion of private school vouchers.
She also named gun-safety legislation and support for townships as priorities.
